items.title: 23.6 Carboxylic acids ki nisbati tezaabiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the relative acidities (PDF 111-112).

blocks.text: Carboxylic acids phenols se kaheen zyada tezaabi hain, aur phenols alcohols se zyada. Tezaab ki taqat, yani woh kis hadd tak ionise hota hai, us ke conjugate base ke istehkaam par munhasir hai. Ethanoic acid ke liye, CH3COOH <=> CH3COO- + H+, Ka = 1.8 x 10^-5 aur pKa = 4.76.

blocks.alt: Ethanoic acid, CH3-C(=O)-O-H (O par -delta, H par +delta), equilibrium mein (teeron par H2O) ethanoate ion, CH3-C(=O)-O-, + H+ ke saath. Ka = 1.8 x 10^-5; pKa = 4.76.
blocks.caption: Ethanoic acid ki ionisation (kitab ke PDF safha 112 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: pKa
blocks.text: pKa = -log Ka. Ka jitna zyada, ya pKa jitna kam, tezaab utna taqatwar.

Ethanoate ion mein manfi charge aik oxygen par nahi rehta: electrons -COO- group par delocalised hote hain, is liye charge dono oxygens mein bat jata hai. Is se ethanoate ion mustahkam hota aur H+ ion le kar dobara ghair-ionised tezaab banane par kam maail hota hai.

blocks.alt: Ethanoate ion ki do resonance banawatein, do-muhe teer se juri: CH3-C(=O)-O- aur CH3-C(-O-)=O. Mure teer dikhate hain ke C=O ke pi electrons aik oxygen par jate hain aur O- ka lone pair wapas C-O bond mein aata hai.
blocks.caption: Ethanoate ion mein manfi charge ka phailao (delocalisation) (kitab ke PDF safha 112 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Mure teer electrons ki harkat dikhate hain: aik oxygen ka manfi charge C-O bond mein aa kar double bond banata hai aur C=O ke pi electrons doosre oxygen par chale jate hain. Dono banawatein barabar hain, yani manfi charge dono oxygens mein bat jata hai aur ion mustahkam hota hai.

Substituents tezaabiyat badalte hain. Electron dene wala group (+I effect) carboxylate ion ke manfi charge ko barha kar use na-mustahkam karta aur tezaab ko kamzor karta hai. Electron kheenchne wala group (-I effect) manfi charge ko phaila kar carboxylate ion ko mustahkam karta aur tezaab ko taqatwar karta hai. Methanoic acid (Ka = 1.8 x 10^-4, pKa 3.75) ethanoic acid (Ka = 1.8 x 10^-5, pKa 4.75) se das guna taqatwar hai, kyunke ethanoic acid ka methyl group electron deta hai. Chlorine atoms taqatwar electron kheenchne wale hain, is liye har izafi chlorine tezaab ko taqatwar karta hai.

blocks.alt: H-COOH, H peele dabbe mein, neeche teer '(-I effect)' tak; Ka = 1.8 x 10^-4, pKa = 3.75. CH3-COOH, CH3 dabbe mein, neeche teer '(+I effect)' tak; Ka = 1.8 x 10^-5, pKa = 4.75.
blocks.caption: Methanoic acid aur ethanoic acid ka muqabla (kitab ke PDF safha 112 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: CH3 group electrons carboxylate ki taraf dhakelta hai (+I effect), manfi charge barhta hai aur ethanoic acid kamzor hota hai. H ko kitab '-I' likhti hai; asal mein H muqable ka maayar (reference) hai jis ka koi khaas inductive asar nahi; farq CH3 ke +I asar se hai, is liye methanoic acid taqriban 10 guna taqatwar hai (Ka 10^-4 banam 10^-5). Kitab ne '(-1 effect)' aur '(+1 effect)' chhapa hai; sahi harf I hai.

blocks.alt: Acetic acid (pKa = 4.74), chloroacetic acid (2.86), dichloroacetic acid (1.26) aur trichloroacetic acid (0.64) ki khuli banawatein: CH3 wale carbon ke aik, do aur teen H ki jagah Cl. Gulabi mota teer daen taraf: 'Stronger acid'.
blocks.caption: Acetic acid aur us ke chlorine wale tezaab (kitab ke PDF safha 112 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har Cl atom electrons apni taraf kheenchta hai (-I effect) aur carboxylate ion ka manfi charge phaila deta hai, is liye jitne zyada Cl, utna mustahkam ion aur utna taqatwar tezaab: pKa 4.74 se 0.64 tak girta hai.

blocks.prompt: Methanoic acid ethanoic acid se taqatwar hai. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid ka methyl group COO- group ki taraf electrons dhakelta (+I effect), us ka manfi charge barhata aur ethanoate ion ko na-mustahkam karta hai; methanoate mein sirf H hai, is liye is ka ion zyada mustahkam hai.

blocks.prompt: CH3CH2COOH, CH3CCl2COOH aur CH3CHClCOOH ko taqat ki tarteeb mein likhein, sab se taqatwar pehle.
blocks.explanation: CH3CCl2COOH > CH3CHClCOOH > CH3CH2COOH: COOH group ke saath zyada chlorine atoms zyada taqatwar -I effect dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Samjhayein ke ethanoic acid ethanol se taqatwar tezaab kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: Ethanoate ion mein manfi charge do oxygen atoms par delocalised hai; ethoxide ion mein yeh aik oxygen par rehta aur ethyl group ka +I effect use barhata hai. Ethanoate kaheen zyada mustahkam hai, is liye ethanoic acid zyada ionise hota hai.

items: Tezaabiyat: carboxylic acids > phenols > paani > alcohols.
Ethanoate do O atoms par delocalisation se mustahkam.
+I groups kamzor, -I groups (Cl) taqatwar karte; HCOOH > CH3COOH.
